descriptions.notStarted: You have now reached the apex of the Maple World, the one who is considered the ultimate Pirate. To commemorate your incredible accomplishment of reaching level 200,  #b#p2081500##k has something in store for you.
descriptions.inProgress: It's the one thing that countless Pirates, the undisputed masters of the sea, strived for, but couldn't get...but now, #p2081500# is introducing me to #t1902002#... I heard only the very best in the world of Maple can be friends with #p2081100#
descriptions.completed: At a point where I never thought I could go any higher, I made a new friend that certainly put me over the top!  With him at my side, nothing can stop me!
